workersAtInterrupt.name: pipeline-runner
workersAtInterrupt.note: The native shell worker survived the message. No duplicate runner was started. Progress resumes from the same live Bexar process and the landed set in leg5_pipelines_progress.json.

sequence: Ector re-key plus geometry scorer plus county-ledger materialize

footprintPilotGate.county: choose one small staged-ready county at footprint leg boundary
footprintPilotGate.beforeRun: Record measured reference, plan budget, apply budget, and 1.5x halt threshold.
footprintPilotGate.haltRule: If staged-geometry join exceeds 1.5x budget, halt and EXPLAIN. Apply #335 TEMP plus GiST shape before retry.

tightening.floodRule: Consume L15 #338-format NDJSON only when the stored digest matches. Never re-plan a digest-matching payload.
tightening.postScorerRule: After every scorer, run countyLedgerMaterializeCli --apply. SQL and the materialized snapshot are ledger truth until P-14 serve verification.
